name: ruralhealth-ai
description: AI-assisted health screening platform for rural frontline health workers, with offline-first capture and Gemini-backed risk analysis.

comments.layout: The React app lives in frontend/ with its own package-lock.json, and the Django app in backend/ with requirements.lock.txt. These scripts drive both from the repository root so a fresh clone has one obvious entry point; they are the same commands CI runs.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix frontend && cd backend && python -m ruff format .
scripts.audit:deps: npm run audit:frontend && npm run audit:backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
